info.name: WeTravel Partner Access token Leads API

description.content: WeTravel Partner API — Trip Builder, Bookings/Orders, Payments (payment links), Transactions, Suppliers and Leads. Enables travel companies to programmatically create WeTravel trip and booking pages and sync customers, orders and transactions. Harvested from the WeTravel Developer Hub per-endpoint OpenAPI fragments (developer.wetravel.com). Paths normalized to the https://api.wetravel.com/v2 base.
